name: bot-file
body: A bot is three markdown fields plus token pointers, saved as JSON. Identity is a persona file. Knowledge is AGENTS.md-shaped project context. Behavior is a list of processes, not a third file; drag a process onto the bot to add one; the list is readable on the info panel. The file holds token references, never keys. No UUID: path plus commit history is the version; the file carries the name only. MCP covers capabilities; do not invent a parallel system. Tree nodes keep their guids; that is loom-warp, not this file.
